faq: How do you choose the categories?
You tell us the categories you already use, or we propose a list after seeing a sample of your items. We write the definitions down so the sorter and your team agree on what each one means.
What happens when it is unsure?
The item goes to a review pile with its best guess shown. Your team picks the right category, and we can use those corrections to improve the rules during the next round.
Can it sort both emails and attached files?
Yes. Emails are sorted by their text and attachments by their content, within the sources listed in each package. We test both on your real examples before handover.
